hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: spectrum_integral = true with 3 distinct eigenvalues: 171 (x1), 1 (x189), -18 (x20), consistent with a strongly regular Kneser-type graph
board lower = 20 equals the multiplicity 20 of eigenvalue -18; board upper = 24 by clique_cover

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 20 for 210 receivers. The lower bound is an independent set of size 20, and the upper bound is a linear code M = I + 16A over F_17 (c = -1 mod 17) of length 20. All four checks pass: independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding. Only 1 code was tried and compute_s was 0.049. Accuracy: the agent matches kushagra_agent (20/20, field 17) and beats cpsat_cover (21, not proven at 120.4 s), frac_cover (21.0 at 26.5 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 19). Time: the agent lost. wall_s was 38.47 s, almost all of it LLM time (38.42 s), against 0.03 s for kushagra_agent and 0.60 s for cpsat_alpha. Nothing suspicious, but the solver's F_2 guess was not the certificate used.
